workspace.text: Hi Alison. I've checked Elena's and David's calendars. The only time that works for all four of us is Thursday, November 19 at 14:30. Please go ahead and book that time. I'll wait for your confirmation before sending the email.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Great, I've booked the meeting for Thursday, November 19 at 14:30. It's in the system. You can go ahead and send the confirmation email.
